business_summary: Hunan Airbluer Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. provides environmental protection services in China. The company offers rural domestic sewage treatment, domestic waste treatment, rural water ecology and industrial and mining area ecological governance, municipal solid waste treatment, agricultural non-point source pollution control, industrial waste gas and water treatment, and pollution farmland management and remediation, as well as rural aquatic ecology and ecological treatment solutions. It also provides investment and financing, consulting and design, project operation and management, engineering contracting, equipment manufacturing and sales, and production and sales of agents and remediation plants services. In addition, the company offers environmental consulting; environmental technology promotion services; environmental protection monitoring; manufacturing special environmental protection equipment; engineering, procurement, and construction services; construction of environmental protection facilities; municipal public works construction; manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of organic and microbial fertilizers; production and sales of insect protein feed; biotechnology development services; sales of agricultural products; manufacturing of mechanical and electrical equipment and components; manufacturing of power facilities and materials; manufacturing of photovoltaic equipment and components; research and development of offshore wind power related systems, power distribution switch control equipment, and motors and their control systems; manufacturing of power distribution switch control equipment; software development; information technology and enterprise management consulting services; energy storage technology services; blockchain technology related software; and power generation, transmission, and distribution services. Hunan Airbluer Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is based in Changsha, China.
